file_insights.purpose: Disk-based persistence layer for BM25Okapi indexes using pickle serialization
key_components: save() - persists index and paths to disk
load() - deserializes and returns index with validation
design_decisions: Stores BM25 index and paths together in single dict for consistency
Uses pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL for optimal serialization performance
Implements parent directory auto-creation for convenience
Graceful error handling with loguru logging throughout

test_categories: Save operations: file creation, directory creation, overwrites, None handling
Load operations: nonexistent files, round-trip persistence, format validation
Delete operations: file removal, nonexistent file handling
Validation: structure checks, missing keys, empty files, corrupted data
